findings.message: The /opt/demo directory ownership and permissions are changed from 584792:584792 mode 0750 to 0:0 mode 0700. The _daemon_ run-user (UID/GID 584792) can no longer read the directory under mode 0700 with root ownership. The service command requires access to /opt/demo/server.conf before listening, with no fallback or runtime capability override. This breaks the application at startup. Restore the previous ownership or establish permissions that preserve service functionality.

Ownership of /opt/demo is changed from chown 584792:584792 to chown 0:0. Combined with the mode reduction to 0700, the non-root run-user loses access. Confirm in the PR that this change is intentional, document the new permission model, and verify that the service functions under the new ownership.

summary: Commit 0000000000000000000000000000000000000011 changes /opt/demo directory ownership from daemon (584792:584792) to root (0:0) and mode from 0750 to 0700. The non-root _daemon_ run-user cannot read the directory or access server.conf. The application requires this file at startup with no fallback, making this a runtime regression.
